title: He Reigns
lyrics: It's the [D]song of the redeemed [A/C#]rising from the African [E]plain.

It's ev'ry tribe, ev'ry [D]tongue, ev'ry nation;
a [A/C#]love song born of a grateful [E]choir.
Let it [D]rise above the four winds, [A/C#]caught up in the heavenly [E]sound.
